base_programmer_1_checkpoint.role: Sole implementation base, per the Two-Programmer-Comparison audit's recommendation.

reference_programmer_2_checkpoint.role: Read-only reference only. Never used as an implementation base or replacement. Only the four named improvements in §8.1 of the merge instructions were ported, each re-implemented inside Programmer 1's architecture rather than copied wholesale.

merge_scope: Controlled merge closing the three blocking findings (F1/F2/F3) of the Deficiency-Closure Independent Audit against Programmer 1's checkpoint, plus the four explicitly allowed ports from Programmer 2 (§8.1). No Batch 10.5, UI, Clipboard, Download, Backup/Restore, Prompt Pack, Export Center, persistence-write, browser-filesystem, or external-integration implementation was started.

findings_addressed.F1: A selected Output B could survive a deleted/omitted selected Output A in a pair-bearing scope (exact audit reproduction: remove selected A, add a valid A omission + matching issue, keep selected B, mark plan partial). validateSelectedB now requires a genuine matching selected Output A for the same (sessionId, sceneId) whenever scope.policy.outputA is true, reusing validateSelectedA's already-trusted result. Idea ported from Programmer 2's validateSelectedOutputB check, re-implemented inside Programmer 1's ValidatedPackagePlanIndex architecture.
findings_addressed.F2: The validator only checked bare uniqueness (or nothing) for sessions/executionPlans/covers/groupPlans, never reconciled project identity against scope.projectId, and content construction still read raw plan.selection.project/versions/artworks/outputsA/outputsB/groupPlans/validationResults directly (exact audit reproduction: selection.project.id forged while scope.projectId unchanged). Adds validateProject, validateSessions, validateScenes, validateExecutionPlans, validateCovers, validateArtworks, validateVersions, validateValidationResults, and validateProvenance, each anchored against scope/numbering/groups. ValidatedPackagePlanIndex now exposes project/versionsById/artworksById/validationResultsBySession. buildPackageContentEntries, buildPromptMetadataJson, and buildValidationJson consume these validated, session-scoped slices instead of raw plan.selection.* arrays.
findings_addressed.F3: A selected group plan's groupNumber could contradict its own selected group's authoritative groupNumber while groupNumbering agreed with the forged value (exact audit reproduction: selection.groups[0].groupNumber 1->9 with matching groupNumbering rows, but selection.groupPlans[0].groupNumber stays 1). validateGroupPlans now requires each group plan's groupNumber to equal the real selected group's own field from the already-validated group index, with omission-aware completeness when policy.groupPlans requires one.

ported_from_programmer_2: Selected-B-requires-matching-selected-A check (idea only; re-implemented in package-plan-validation.ts, not copied as a file).
Real validateExportManifestShape import into the external ZIP verifier, replacing a local Ajv schema compile.
Real compareUtf8 import into the external ZIP verifier, replacing a local Buffer.compare reimplementation.
On-disk extracted-file reconciliation split into an independent, testable module (scripts/zip-external-verification.mts).
explicitly_not_ported_from_programmer_2: The five-map ValidatedPackagePlanIndex (Programmer 1's wider, fully-reconciled index is kept and extended).
Mutable Maps typed as ReadonlyMap (Programmer 1's genuine runtime-immutable ReadonlyMapView is kept).
The less-strict ZIP writer (Programmer 1's strict property-descriptor-snapshot writer is kept unchanged).
The 11-row, partly-manual external verification command (the 13-row automatic structure is kept).
architecture_note: src/export/packaging/package-plan-validation.ts is the single typed validation boundary. package.ts calls validatePackagePlanIntegrity(plan, limits) once; buildPackageContentEntries, buildPromptMetadataJson, and buildValidationJson consume only the validated ValidatedPackagePlanIndex. Architecture tests (test/export-engine/packaging/architecture.test.ts) statically assert content.ts never imports the whole ExportPlan type, and that package.ts/package-plan.ts/manifest.ts never read a raw plan.selection.* category after the validation gate.
